summary: OWNH covers fewer than ten repositories, dozens of owners and tens of thousands of lines. Ownership is concentrated: Ada Lindqvist holds 54.4%, compared with Mira Quist at 10.6% and Umar Lindqvist at 6.5%; blank lines account for 20.5% of lines, and the reported punctuation-only line categories account for 6.4% and 6.3%, all owned by Ada Lindqvist.

Cross-repository authorship is substantial: lines written elsewhere account for 80% in billing-service, 78% in web-frontend and 66% in api-gateway. Ownership by non-contributors ranges from 0% in web-frontend to 57% in api-gateway; ownership methods agree in no repositories.

At 2026 Q2, principal-owner share is 54.3%, up from 51.2% at 2025 Q3, while inactive-owner share is 76.3%, down from 77.9%; both majorities are established. The next blank-line milestone is projected for 2031 Q4, and line survival has a half-life of 2 years.

okr.objective: Improve ownership resilience and measurement consistency across the portfolio.

keyResults.text: Lower principal-owner concentration from the 2026 Q2 baseline of 54.3%, which rose from 51.2% at 2025 Q3.
Reduce inactive-owner share from the 2026 Q2 baseline of 76.3%; it has eased from 77.9% at 2025 Q3 but remains a majority, held since 2023 Q4.
Increase ownership-method agreement from a baseline of no repositories at 2026 Q2.
